title: sopuli-dba streamed event
description: One JSON object per line, emitted by `sopuli … --output jsonl` as the run progresses. The final run.finished event carries the same summary as the --output json document. Draft — not yet implemented (#9). 1.1 therefore adds an event nothing emits: `password.displayed` is registered with the path that causes it (#441, UC-2's seen reset) rather than with the stream that will carry it, so the word is decided by the change that knows why the event exists. The exposure is recorded today in the run document, which every run has. 1.2 adds `password.delivered` on the same terms (#444): UC-2 6.3 says every delivery emits one, and it is registered with the change that builds the first unseen method rather than with the stream that will carry it. Neither event carries the password, and neither carries the retrieval credential an unseen delivery hands back -- `results[].handover` in the run document is where a consumer finds the accessor that names it.

seq.description: Monotonic within a run. Consumers may use gaps to detect truncation.

data.description: Event-specific payload. Shapes are reused from the run schema: target.finished carries a $defs/result, run.finished carries a $defs/summary and exit_code, plan.resolved carries a $defs/plan.

then.description: Never carries the password. The data object may carry only the vault version and the action outcome.
